name: which of the three layouts a screen gets

mutants.name: a desktop needs width alone, not height
mutants.find: if (wide >= DesktopWide && tall >= DesktopTall && wide > tall) return View.Desktop;
mutants.replace: if (wide >= DesktopWide && wide > tall) return View.Desktop;

mutants.name: a desktop may be portrait
mutants.find: if (wide >= DesktopWide && tall >= DesktopTall && wide > tall) return View.Desktop;
mutants.replace: if (wide >= DesktopWide && tall >= DesktopTall) return View.Desktop;

mutants.name: a desktop needs height alone, not width
mutants.find: if (wide >= DesktopWide && tall >= DesktopTall && wide > tall) return View.Desktop;
mutants.replace: if (tall >= DesktopTall && wide > tall) return View.Desktop;

mutants.name: a tablet must also be landscape, as the desktop must
mutants.replace: return wide >= TabletWide && wide > tall ? View.Tablet : View.Phone;

mutants.name: the thresholds are exclusive rather than inclusive
mutants.find: if (wide >= DesktopWide && tall >= DesktopTall && wide > tall) return View.Desktop;
mutants.replace: if (wide > DesktopWide && tall > DesktopTall && wide > tall) return View.Desktop;
